messages:
maria (Finance): flagged invoice INV-2026-03 — billed tokens 2,302,456 but metered tokens 1,847,912. Can billing ops explain? Need to reconcile before we send Q1 report.

raj (BillingOps): looking. which customer? any specific model or endpoint?

maria (Finance): cust-acme, endpoint "embed-ingest-prod", period 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-21. tags show a large jump on 2026-03-18.

lucy (EngTelemetry): we had a retry/backfill job that day. There's a known issue where retries were double-counted if backfill used "bill=true". investigating.

jonah (Support): acme reported increased invoice yesterday. They're asking why tokens doubled.

lucy (EngTelemetry): paste log snippet:
```text
2026-03-18T03:12:07Z backfill_worker INFO processing batch id=bf-987 retry=1 tokens=120345
2026-03-18T03:12:07Z billing_write WARN write_billed_tokens customer=cust-acme batch=bf-987 tokens=120345
2026-03-18T03:12:08Z backfill_worker INFO processing batch id=bf-987 retry=2 tokens=120345
2026-03-18T03:12:08Z billing_write WARN write_billed_tokens customer=cust-acme batch=bf-987 tokens=120345
```

lucy (EngTelemetry): root cause: backfill retries didn't check dedup idempotency key; billing writer accepted both.

raj (BillingOps): that would explain ~480k tokens. We can either issue a credit or run a correction (negative invoice). What's preferred, @sophie?

sophie (Head of Finance): prefer one-time credit and updated invoice. Need to confirm amount and get approval for >$5k credits.

maria (Finance): estimate credit ~ $1,136.36 (using $0.0025/token). can we validate exact token delta?

raj (BillingOps): I'll run reconciliation script now: `/ops/billing/reconcile_backfills.py --cust cust-acme --since 2026-03-14`. Will post results.

reconciliation-bot: job started: id=rec-20260318-01 queued

raj (BillingOps): result: delta_tokens=454,544 delta_amount=1,136.36 USD. verified by lucy.

lucy (EngTelemetry): confirm dedup patch merged: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/432 - ensures idempotency key "backfill_batch_id". Also scheduled a re-run to avoid future duplicates.

maria (Finance): ok proceed with issuing credit. @sophie please approve.

sophie (Head of Finance): approved. Finance to issue credit, note in invoice memo "reconciliation: duplicate backfill tokens Mar18".

raj (BillingOps): putting credit in system now, will push updated invoice end of day. Notifying customer.

jonah (Support): i'll send a short note to acme: "we identified billing duplicate from backfill job; issuing credit of $1,136.36; updated invoice will arrive today." anything else?

maria (Finance): please CC finance and ops. Add a short postmortem to #incidents.

lucy (EngTelemetry): quick note on rate limits: we should ensure that retries due to 429 are not billed. opened issue: github.com/redwood/platform/issues/289

maria (Finance): thanks all :thumbsup:
